name: PR Brief — summary, risk areas, review focus and the jump to Files changed
description: Walks the Overview tab's PR Brief section (L06) on the seeded brief for PR #482 (server/src/db/seed-brief.ts, written through the same atomic JSONB merge as the Prior PRs history, so flow 13 still finds its history next to it): the summary, a risk pill, the 'Review focus — read these first' card, a click on its first row jumping to Files changed with ?tab=diff&file=…&line=…, a reload and a Back that honour the URL (AC-17), and a click on a blast-only file (src/server.ts is a caller in the blast map, not a changed file) that stays on Overview and shows the 'File not in this PR's diff' notice (EC-6). The seeded pr_files rows carry no patch, so the line scroll falls back to the card top (EC-7); the line anchor itself is proven in DiffTab.test.tsx. Never clicks Generate brief or Refresh — both call the LLM. Read-only seeded data, no model call. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml.
